statements.t: The Company also announced that it will be delaying its full earnings release and restating certain prior period financial statements to correct departures from GAAP related to those periods.
"Years of investment in our agents, service organization and proprietary technology have created a platform that pairs personal guidance with digital convenience and broad product choice.
We are reaffirming guidance for the full year 2026 as follows:

The Company preliminarily expects employee compensation and benefits to decrease and income from operations to increase by approximately 0.5% to 5.5% of employee compensation and benefits for each of the full year ended December 31, 2025 and the interim periods ended June 30, 2026 and March 31, 2026, with related effects on tax expense and other assets.

We preliminarily expect both total revenue and general and administrative expenses to increase by equivalent amounts in the ranges of approximately $11 million to $16 million for the year ended December 31, 2025 and approximately $5.5 million to $8.5 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026.

The Company intends to file an amendment to its Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (the “Form 10-K/A”) to restate the financial statements for the Annual Periods, including the comparative financial information for 2024 and 2023, and for the quarterly and year-to-date periods ended September 30, June 30 and March 31 of 2025 and 2024.
The Company intends to file these amendments as soon as practicable.
